title: Head positions in a seam configuration
statement: For any input, states $l,l'$, register valuation $v$, output word, and registers $r,s$, changing a seam configuration from state $(l,\mathrm{start})$ to $(l',\mathrm{start})$ by setting both register-head positions to zero gives exactly the seam configuration with state $(l',\mathrm{start})$.
